arithmetic.finalize_count: An idle healthy finalize invokes tick (2N audits), then its explicit ownership audit once: 2N+1. Standalone status performs N audits for N reserved results. This excludes the separate work of collecting/pinning the final evidence.
arithmetic.general_expression: 2R audits × A(A−1)/2 = R A(A−1) containment checks per idle tick; 2RA executable verifications. In the equal all-success case R=A=N, these become N²(N−1) and 2N² respectively.
arithmetic.interpretation: The large-N values are source-level operation-count projections, not elapsed-time or throughput estimates. Warm cache may lower physical reads but not bytes passed through the hasher.

logical_bytes_example.assumption: same 8,020,928-byte interpreter for each job; logical hashed bytes, not physical device I/O

arithmetic.per_audit_live_hashing: ownership_audit loops over all A intents and calls validate(spec); validate performs live validation, including verify_executable. That is A executable verifications per audit, assuming one executable per intent.
arithmetic.per_audit_pairs: ownership_intents constructs the full retained intent list and checks every unordered pair for output-path overlap: A(A-1)/2 comparisons.
arithmetic.source_call_path: _tick_locked iterates all released reservations and calls verified_result; it then calls _status_snapshot which calls verified_result for every job. For a reserved result, verified_result calls ownership_for_job; ownership_for_job rebuilds ownership_expected and calls ownership_audit. Thus the stated healthy case has 2R audits per idle tick.

benchmark_design_assessment.safety_and_representativeness: A 1 KiB no-fork fixture with at most 16 launches is a reasonable first queue-overhead pilot only. It can validate small-N call counts and overhead under the observed host/cache conditions; it cannot establish model-cycle cost, active scientific worker behavior, long-tail storage stalls, H-root coordinator behavior, or thousands-scale service behavior. The planned 1/2/4/8 prefixes should be explicitly cumulative on one history (rather than four independent cohorts), or label repeated admissions precisely; first-batch 16 cap remains a safety ceiling.
benchmark_design_assessment.scratch_and_source: Use a new caller-selected scratch root on the same intended filesystem, preserve exact source paths/pins, and send all receipts/cleanup output outside the frozen source packet. Do not move/copy the store to make authenticated history; report same-mount and cache conditions. The source packet correctly identifies that current run_tests.sh rewrites cleanup-verification.json if run in place.
strengths: Runs source-bound frozen code in fresh temporary stores rather than fabricated history.
Small real no-fork subprocess payload and capacity one, explicit launch cap, no model jobs.
Separates completed idle ticks, status, active polling, completion, restart, seal and finalize; compares plan shape and dependencies separately.
Requires record of P/J/R/A/E/H and actual accepted/released evidence; leaves operation checks enabled.
Requires scratch output and explicitly avoids executing the source-changing cleanup test script in place.
Separates logical hashing from physical storage reads and does not treat test durations as thousands-cycle results.

limitations: I ran only the four arithmetic tests in the scaling packet; I did not import the queue, execute fixtures, inspect active jobs, or run a benchmark.

Complexity analysis is conditional on one root, all N jobs having reservations and retained executor intents, fully valid releases, no early exits/corruption/lock contention, and equal N relationships. Partial, dependency-heavy, failure, retry, and active-job states have different paths.
The source pins establish source identity at review time, not historical runtime attestation.
The design’s first benchmark is not yet implemented; workload control, cleanup, resource, and successful durable returns require independent review once a harness exists.
missing_active_owner_load_controls: No explicit pre-run exclusion/admission rule for concurrent owner scientific jobs or queue managers. The “fresh resource check” is not operationalized as a recorded owner workload snapshot.

No before/during/after samples of host CPU load/run queue, memory pressure, disk I/O/latency, filesystem free space/inodes, or cgroup/job-level CPU/memory/I/O counters. Nice 15 and controller RSS alone do not isolate queue cost from shared workload.

No owned process-tree aggregate CPU/RSS/PSS measurement; detached supervisor/child and manager observations should be recorded separately from the benchmark controller. RSS summation risks double-counting shared pages, so state the accounting method.

No explicit policy for owner job starts during a batch: pause/abort while preserving current root/reservation state, or tag that interval as contaminated and exclude only by predeclared rules (never silently discard samples).
No repeated baseline/control runs to quantify timing noise, nor a fixed warm-cache/cold-cache condition. Report cache policy and avoid dropping global caches; compare like with like.

No threshold tied to reserved owner headroom beyond proposed per-operation, scratch, and observed-controller-RSS caps. Root should bind the actual live resource envelope and stop rule before the first trial.
verdict: The source-derived complexity arithmetic is correct for the explicitly stated all-success, same-root assumptions. It establishes no measured performance or thousands-cycle capability. The proposed tiny pilot is bounded and scientifically irrelevant to models, but should add explicit shared-owner-load controls before execution.
